name: Ziing
notes: Full original board inspected, including all nine product swatches, 17 named typography specimens, ten paired button appearances, logo/favicon and complete icon board. Presentation labels, font showcase and board gray are excluded from product tokens.

Six palette names follow captured paint-style evidence. Cream (#F0EEE1), vivid-yellow (#FAFF5B) and gray (#C1BEBF) are descriptive fallback IDs for hex-labeled swatches whose variable names are unavailable; labels preserve those documented hex strings.

Button families: primary shares joined-pill default and split label-pill/icon-circle hover across Blue, Black, Yellow, Orange and Light Blue. Video uses the same split interaction but a distinct 24px play glyph, 8px default gap and asymmetric default padding. Arrow is icon-only in Black/Blue, with unchanged measured hover appearance. Link shares underline/highlight structure across black and white text colorways. No standalone hover variants.

Button nodes bind complete interactive states. Black frames behind white inline links are presentation backgrounds, so links bind their complete inner groups. Circular-arrow accessible labels are descriptive and must remain visually hidden.

Identical CTA arrow glyphs/paint reuse the icon-board black and white arrow exports; video default/hover reuse the exact video-play export. Icon-board Arrow-Right and Play-Button have distinct captured paths and remain separate assets. Logos/favicon/credit are excluded from the icon sprite.

Typography follows measured TEXT specimens over annotation text: Button Text is Auto line height, Source is underlined with -0.01em tracking. No mobile sizes, h5/h6 or unambiguous paragraph mapping are documented. CAP_HEIGHT leading trim exists on Feature Header, Header 3, Header 4, Stat body and Resource stat header; the supplied schema has no leading-trim field.

Neulis Sans is the only product typography family; host font resolution should match the attached NeulisSans family. Weights 300–700 are used. Asset and license paths are host-resolved placeholders per the required contract, not a claim of OFL licensing.

Spacing is copied verbatim from host evidence (e25-spacing-v1; variables unavailable). Radii and standard E25 breakpoints/container use the task's prescribed defaults. Per-button radii retain measured values.

Body font derives from named Body specimens. White background, Black foreground and Blue focus use the product palette as explicit semantic defaults; the board does not document a focus-state specimen or global page-background assignment.
Browser rendering, host font resolution and the complete host SVG export pipeline remain unverified in this extraction-only run.
The host exports each item in labeled icon/logo rows, including unnamed vectors. Button paints are read from the mapped Figma states; empty fills stay transparent.
Styles use the selected breakpoint system. Generate the E25 padded Container separately after applying the style guide. Google families use next/font/google; custom families use the attached files.
Figma variables could not be read. Using the default 30-token spacing scale and its spacing safelist.
